name: jaenvtix
description: Maven monorepo provisioner for VS Code: per-project Java/Maven, multi-vendor JDK, multi-module inheritance, security auto-updates, consent-based.

jaenvtix.enableRuntimePathFix.markdownDescription: When enabled, Jaenvtix attempts to recover invalid `java.configuration.runtimes` paths (e.g. a user who pointed to `bin/` instead of the JDK root) before removing the entry. Disable to always remove broken entries without trying to fix the path.

jaenvtix.applyJavaTunings.description: Apply sensible Java tunings (hotCodeReplace, maxConcurrentBuilds, packagePresentation, organizeImports threshold, test.config UTF-8 on Windows) to User Settings on first run. Set to false to opt out.

jaenvtix.configureOptionalExtensions.description: Auto-configure detected companion extensions (Spring Boot Tools, etc.) to use the right JDK.

jaenvtix.discoverFromToolchainsXml.description: Read ~/.m2/toolchains.xml as a source of JDK discovery. Disable if you don't want Jaenvtix to inspect this file.

enumDescriptions: Default logic: Oracle for LTS 21+, then Corretto, then Temurin.
Oracle JDK (LTS 21+ only; falls back otherwise).
Microsoft Build of OpenJDK (LTS releases only).
jaenvtix.preferredJdkVendor.description: Preferred vendor to download JDK from. 'auto' uses the default logic (Oracle for 21+ LTS, Corretto then Temurin as fallback). If the chosen vendor URL is unreachable, Jaenvtix falls back to the next available vendor automatically.

jaenvtix.autoUpdatePatches.description: Periodically check (every 24h) whether a newer patch of a Jaenvtix-cached JDK is available and re-download it to pick up security fixes. Never touches JDKs installed outside the Jaenvtix cache.

jaenvtix.downloadMaxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed downloads (timeout, 5xx, connection reset). Set 0 to disable retries.

jaenvtix.isolatedMavenPerProject.description: When a pom.xml pins a Maven version (<prerequisites><maven> or <properties><maven.version>), provision that exact Maven in an isolated ~/.jaenvtix/jdk-N/mvn-<version>/ slot and point the project at it. Disable to share a single Jaenvtix Maven across all projects.

scripts.pretest: bun run compile && bun run lint
